chosen_title: Empirical Analysis of Cybersecurity Trust Deficits in QR-Based Mobile Payment Adoption Among Semi-Rural Malaysian Micro-Enterprises

papers.title: Cybersecurity Vulnerabilities and Consumer Trust in Malaysian Cashless Payment Ecosystems
papers.abstract: Digital payment solutions have surged across urban Malaysian commercial centers. However, fraud vectors, unauthorized micro-transactions, and QR code tampering remain key obstacles for small micro-merchants.

papers.title: DuitNow QR Adoption Factors in Rural Malaysian Traditional Retailers: A TOE Framework Analysis
papers.abstract: Drawing on the Technology-Organization-Environment (TOE) framework, this research evaluates national interoperable QR code integration among rural grocery merchants across Pahang and Kelantan.

papers.title: Determinants of E-Wallet Adoption among Malaysian Small and Medium Enterprises: A UTAUT2 Perspective
papers.abstract: This study examines the behavioral intentions of Malaysian SMEs toward continuous adoption of digital e-wallets using an extended UTAUT2 model incorporating transaction security.

papers.title: Mobile Payment System Architecture and Compliance with Bank Negara Malaysia Regulatory Framework
papers.abstract: Architectural analysis of payment gateway latency, compliance requirements under the Financial Services Act 2013, and customer authentication protocols.

papers.title: Fintech Adoption In Retail Food and Beverage Micro-Enterprises Across Johor Southern Corridor
papers.abstract: Investigating operational transitions from physical cash handling to DuitNow QR and Touch 'n Go eWallet platforms during post-pandemic recovery among hawkers in Iskandar Malaysia.

papers.title: Assessing AI-Based Credit Scoring and Fraud Detection for Unbanked Micro-Merchants in Southeast Asia
papers.abstract: A machine learning framework using e-wallet transaction velocity to predict credit default and fraudulent behavior among micro-entrepreneurs lacking conventional records.
